description: Declarative remote estate for the Claude Design studio (projectId in config.json). Reconciliation contract: at every ordinary sync, list the remote project and DELETE any file whose path matches no glob or literal below ('dir/**' matches any depth but does NOT match dot-prefixed names at any level — every dot-prefixed keep must be a literal entry, as the .thumbnail entries are; all other entries are literal paths). Every intentional addition to the remote estate lands as an entry here in the same change. Adopted by owner ruling 2026-07-25 (MCP-160; retires the MCP-137 S4 no-prune deviation). Derived from the ruled disposition of all 346 then-remote files — evidence pack: .agent/state/collaboration/handoffs/2026-07-25-cormorant-walk-pack/.

shippedFromRepo.description: Repo is canonical; the converter pipeline and the studio-source up-sync re-ship these current each sync (converter outputs; the five tier CSS files + oak-theme.js + brand_voice.txt per the MCP-137 S4 scope ruling; the asset cargo; and the studio-source surfaces tracked in packages/design/oak-design-system/studio-source/).

directWrites.description: Shipped current from repo canonicals by explicit DesignSync writes each sync, because the converter cannot carry them: tokensGlob requires an installed tokensPkg (absent), and guidelinesGlob accepts .md/.mdx only (verified: lib/docs.mjs matchGlob/isDocExt). Owner rulings 2026-07-25: dtcg ships by direct write; the three non-md docs ship because the design agent is a reviewing expert.

sources.CLAUDE.md: packages/design/oak-design-system re-trued canonical (the studio's normative accessibility / multi-medium instruction; authored from the live studio copy at the MCP-160 curation sync)

machinery.description: Working files of the studio app and of the sync itself; reconciliation keeps them. The sync writes _ds_sync.json (last, as the anchor); the studio app owns the rest — each keeps a remote capability working with no repo twin needed (owner ruling 2026-07-25: parity is of impact and capability, not mechanisms).

pending: SKILL.md — CONDITIONAL (owner formula 2026-07-25): a usefulness read decides adopt-into-the-skills-estate (its entry stays and gains a repo source) or delete-in-both-places (its entry is removed here in the same change).

_ds_bundle.css and _adherence.oxlintrc.json — VERIFY rows from the ruled disposition: live checks at the MCP-160 curation sync decide keep (entries stay) or delete (entries removed here in the same change).

_ds_bundle.js — studio-native compiled component bundle, kept until the owned component tier replaces it (component-tier contract, which also carries the dc-runtime impact-equivalence obligation); the replacing sync moves it from machinery to shippedFromRepo.
